recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, wide-shot aerial view of a small, dark wooden log raft floating in a vast, choppy, dark teal-grey ocean. A single figure dressed entirely in white stands on the raft, holding a map or scroll. The composition is centered and minimalist, emphasizing the scale of the water relative to the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the white figure and the dark, monochromatic water
Centralized subject placement creating a focal point in a vast expanse
Textural contrast between the rough, dark logs and the fluid, rippling water
Vertical hierarchy with text positioned directly above the central figure
coreInvariants: Small scale of the subject relative to the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The raft and figure are centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 10% of the total frame area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white-clad figure serves as the primary visual anchor due to its high value contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright white figure, moves upward to the text, and then outward to the vast, repetitive texture of the waves.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the ocean, creating a sense of isolation and scale.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to greyscale and desaturated teal

composition.position: Upper center, directly above the raft

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface with varying tracking or a vertical separator bar.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure and professional presence
Open counters and modern geometric feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-angle aerial view of a vast, dark, desaturated teal ocean with small, choppy waves. In the center, place a small raft made of dark, weathered logs. On the raft, a person stands wearing a white hoodie and white pants, holding a small piece of parchment. The overall mood is cold and isolated.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white, centered above the raft. Use wide tracking and include a thin vertical pipe character to separate the text elements.

verificationChecks: Is the figure clearly white against the dark water?
Is the ocean color desaturated and dark teal?
Is the text centered and small in scale?
Is the tracking on the text wide enough to feel airy?

mustRedesign: Avoid any specific artist logos or monograms
Do not use specific brand names in the text

mustAchieve: High value contrast on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the figure is the brightest point in the image.
Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the water texture is consistent across the frame.
Confirm the desaturated teal palette is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Aerial perspective + centered small subject + high value contrast + desaturated monochromatic environment + minimalist geometric typography.
